characters.name: Flavor Flav
characters.description: Berserk Button: Flav doesn't like his name misspelled. In the 3rd season, he eliminated a girl because of it. Better as Friends: He ends up deciding that he is better off being just friends with Bridgette, Goldie, New York and Hoopz. Catchphrase: He has two of them."Flavor flav!""You know what time it is" "You know what time it is" Elimination Catch Phrase: "Your time's up."

characters.name: Big Rick
characters.description: Best Friend: Towards Flav. They spend a lot of time together bonding. Nice Guy: He's a very polite man towards the girls and he is Flav's best friend. Only Sane Man: Big Rick seems to be one of the most laid back people on this show and he's the main one who tries to deescalate the fights that take place in the house.

characters.name: Hoopz
characters.description: Better as Friends: In the reunion, Flav and Hoopz part ways and admit that they are better off as friends. Even the Loving Hero Has Hated Ones: Hoopz got along with everyone in the house except for New York, which is justified given New York's jerkass behavior towards her. Hidden Depths:During the challenge where the women have to cook chicken for Flav and his mother,tomboyHoopz surprises everyone by being incredible in the kitchen, and even Big Rick asks if he can have some of what she's cooking. During the challenge where the women have to cook chicken for Flav and his mother,tomboyHoopz surprises everyone by being incredible in the kitchen, and even Big Rick asks if he can have some of what she's cooking. The Lad-ette: Hoopz is an athletic, laid-back tomboy who gets along with everyone (except for a short argument with New York, which was considered even by her to be a surprise) and dresses more... modestlythan the other contestants.

characters.name: New York
characters.description: Arrogant Kung-Fu Girl: She has this attitude that she thinks she's so good at playing the game and that she's too good to be allies with everyone. Better as Friends: After curving her twice, Flav and New York agree to just be friends. The Chessmaster: New York played this role well in the 7th episode of season 2 when Krazy was used as anUnwitting Pawnby New York to start a fight so someone can get kicked out. The person who got kicked off was Buckeey. Clingy Jealous Girl: New York in the first season. By episode three she's sobbing because Flav has to leave her for the second challenge of the day. She even comes into his bedroom when other girls are in there sleeping (platonically) with him just to keep an eye on him. Control Freak: This is what led to New York's second elimination. When Flav and New York were spending time together on the boat in the season 2 finale, New York told Flav that she wanted to control his life. This scared Flav, and he told New York that she was actinglike her mother. To avoid dealing with New York, he chose Deelishis at the end.

characters.name: Pumkin
characters.description: Butt-Monkey: Pumkin is portrayed as being awkward, unsexy, uncool, and sheltered in nearly every scene she's in, in comparison to her more confident and sexual rivals. She thinks "OG" stands for "Olive Garden." She fails nearly every challenge she's in: Despite beinga substitute teacher and a cheerleading coachshe is deemed the worst at handling the children's party challenge, she cooks poorly, she does the worst in the Five Senses challenge, and she loses the surprisingly good gains she makes in Las Vegas. Despite all this, she does manage to make it all the way to third place, even if her notoriety is cemented in the "spit heard 'round the world" and getting shoved into a camera because of it. Dirty Coward: Pumkin, for spitting on New York and running away after. It just proves that Pumkin was too afraid to fight NY with her fists. Everything Is Racist: Pumkin can't catch a break. It really is her own fault though; just about everything she says comes off the wrong way. Hypocrite: Pumkin criticized Smiley for wanting to make friends with the other women ("this is Flavor of Love, not Flavor of Friends!"). This is the same woman who criticized New York for not wanting to be friends with the other girls in the house. Sore Loser: Pumkin acted like this when she was eliminated. She even went as far as to pick a fight with New York. Flav even lampshades it when Pumkin left the house for good.

characters.name: Goldie
characters.description: Better as Friends: Flav and Brigitte, Flav and Goldie, Flav and Hoopz. Loved by All: Goldie seems to be liked by almost everybody in the house. She has never argued with anybody, and even New York couldn’t get herself to hate Goldie. Even Goldie herself is kind to everyone as well. Nice Girl: Goldie is a stand out amongst the girls as she is the only girl to act friendly and joyful with nearly every single girl she’s interacted with in spite of the competition, even towards New York. She’s so friendly that the only girl she’s justifiably had issue with was Cherry for blabbing about her puking in a bucket. Perpetual Smiler: Goldie is always smiling and happy in her confessionals. Team Mom: Goldie. Not only is she the best with children, she tends to be the most sympathetic to the other women, even comforting Pumkin when the latter is scared of flying in Flav's private jet.

characters.name: Hottie
characters.description: Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: The other contestants seem to likeNew Yorkmore than they like her. New York flat-out calls her out on this, saying that she herself is at least honest aboutwho she iswhereas Hottie is "a wolf in sheep's clothing." Gold Digger: Hottie. She's pretty blatant about it in confessionals. This (combined with her outrageous lies and two-faced attitude) made her even more unpopular among the other contestants thanNew York herself. Hidden Depths: During the Five Senses challenge, Hottie proves herself to be a shockingly great singer. Goldie dryly comments that everyone hassomethingthey're good at. Small Name, Big Ego: In one of the most memorable scenes from the show, Hottie declares that she looks like Beyoncé. The other women fall to pieces laughing at her. The Un-Favorite: Hottie was obviously not well-liked by the editing team, given the bell-ring whenever she blinks and the admittedly hilarious rendition of her as a devil when she dresses in an unusual cape on the way to church.

characters.name: Red Oyster
characters.description: The Baroness: Red Oyster. Ohhh boy. Red dress, whip, long black hair, serious look on her face... she was trying very hard to be the trope archetype. Lady in Red: Red Oyster deliberately invokes in three ways. The first was when she added "Red" to her nickname when Flav called her Oyster. The second was when she revealed that she was attempting to break a world record by wearing red for so many days. The third is being so iconic and having a fierce personality as well. The Stool Pigeon: Red Oyster loved to snitch to Flav about the other girls. She even gets called out on in at the reunion. When she eliminates herself, the episode preview evenplay it up to be her snitching again.

characters.name: Sweetie
characters.description: Beware the Nice Ones: Sweetie did not take her elimination well. At the reunion show, evenFlavagrees that her elimination was a surprise. In her defense, the other choice was Hottie, who failed the challenge. (They had to cook chicken for his mother. While Sweetiehad to overcome fear of chicken to complete the challenge, Hottie on the other handplaced the chicken in the microwave and set it on "chicken".) Why Did It Have to Be Snakes?: Sweetie has a phobia of chicken.

characters.name: Serious
characters.description: Ms. Fanservice: She missed no chance of showing off her figure, given her wanting to promote modeling career.

characters.name: Miss Latin
characters.description: Never My Fault: Miss Latin gets in on this in the reunion. She constantly insults Red Oyster for snitching on her (even calling her ugly), while ignoring the fact that had she not called her ex-boyfriend in acompetition setting,she wouldn't have gotten eliminated in the first place.

characters.name: Rain
characters.description: Clingy Jealous Girl: Rain, one of the early eliminations, speaks about Flav like they're already dating. Hair-Trigger Temper: This is shown when she gets into averyheated argument with New York in the van.

characters.name: Deelishis
characters.description: Jerkass to One: Deelishis didn't seem to have a problem with anyone except for Krazy, the only one she was antagonistic towards. She also had issues with New York, which was justified since New York was the one who would start arguments with her. Jerkass Has a Point: Deelishis may have been aFalse Friendand a bully towards Krazy, but she was correct to point out that Krazy was wrong to lie to Flav's friends about knowing Flav's music. She was also right to point out that Krazy was wrong for thinking New York was her friend. Ms. Fanservice: There's much emphasis on her hourglass shape.

characters.name: Krazy
characters.description: Bully Magnet: Poor Krazy just wasn’t lucky, as she was a target of bullying by the other girls in the house. Dreadful Musician: Krazy. The show lampshades this by having a glass-breaking effect when she sings. She not exactly abadsinger, but she's shrill and overly dramatic. Fatal Flaw: Krazy’s fatal flaw is her social naivete and being too nice and trusting. Krazy’s problem is that she naively believes that everyone has good intentions and that everyone is trustrowthy and nice like she is, which was why she was too eager to make friends in the house. This unfortunately caused her to be an easy target of bullying in the house. Reality also hit Krazy in the face when Deelishis turns out to be backstabbing and someone not worthy of trust. This is taken even further when New York exploits this side of her by using her as a pawn to get other contestants eliminated. This also comes to bite her in the butt in the second episode of the first season of Charm School when she blindly teams up with Schatar and she promptly gets eliminated since she allowed Schatar’s trickery (stealing her dress) to get under her skin that it interferes with her ability to do well in the challenge of the day. Good Cannot Comprehend Evil: Many contestants always questioned Krazy as to why she would think New York was her friend. Goldie called her out on this at the reunion, as well. It also combines withGood Is Dumbas well. Hated by All: When episode six of season 2 comes in, it's revealed that the women don't seem too fond of Krazy and they would go out their way to do horrible things to her with little to no provocation on Krazy's end. However, this is more of the girls being assholes. New York even exploits this by using Krazy as a pawn to get someone eliminated.

characters.name: Bootz
characters.description: The Bully: Bootz is a mean and nasty bully towards the contestants Payshintz and Krazy. The former even quit after not wanting to deal with her. Hypocrite: Bootz criticized Krazy for trying too hard to make friends, but she would belong to a clique consisting of her, Buckeey and Deelishis. Irrational Hatred: She seemed to hate contestants like Krazy and Payshintz despite those two doing nothing bad to her. Jerkass: Bootz is a very mean, obnoxious, hateful, and an unpleasant person. Jerkass Has a Point: While Bootz was a complete jerkass about it in her argument with Krazy, she was correct when she pointed out on how clueless Krazy was when Krazy was trying to make friends with everyone instead of getting to know Flav. This show is a competition and making friends is the last thing you should do.

characters.name: Buckeey
characters.description: Fatal Flaw: Buckeey is her anger issues and her tendency to be a follower. Since she had issues controlling her anger, she allowed New York to use her as a pawn so that someone would get kicked off (and Buckeey ended up being the one who was eliminated). Since Buckeey had issues controlling her anger, this got her to escalade a mere petty squabble with her and Krazy and it turned physical. This lead to Buckeey getting eliminated because despite Krazy laying hands on her first, Buckeey escalated the fight with more violence and brute force. Buckeey being a follower was the cause of her downfall since she ended up hating Krazy simply because the other girls did (and despite Krazy doing nothing bad to her). New York ended up exploiting this when she used Krazy to gossip about the other girls, knowing that the other ladies disliked Krazy and would viscously confront the latter if Krazy were to run her mouth about them. Irrational Hatred: Her hate for Krazy showed in episode 6 of the show when she voted her the most fakest despite Krazy doing nothing bad to her. Jerkass: She is a very rude and disrespectul person towards a few of the contestants of the show. Jerkass to One: Buckeey treated Like Dat and Krazy much worse than how she treated the other contestants.

characters.name: Buckwild
characters.description: Catchphrase: "It's time to GET BUCKWILD!" Establishing Character Moment: Buckwild introduces herself to Flav by already nicknaming herself and saying "It's time to get Buckwild!"

characters.name: Nibblz
characters.description: Beware the Nice Ones:In a deleted scene of the reunion, Nibblz is shown to be like this. In the show Nibblz was a friendly girl towards the other contestants (even though she's open about enjoying sexual things). She never picked fights with others nor reveled in drama. She confronts New York about the comments the latter made about Nibblz (they were about Nibblz being dirty, filthy, and needing manicures, makeup, and bras) and she viciously insults New York as revenge, telling her that she looks like a man.

characters.name: Toasteee
characters.description: Metaphorically True: In Toasteee's defense, the videos she did in college are nottechnicallyporn. They're actually videos of her wearing nothing but a thong,strangling fully clothed men with her thighs. ......Or So I Heard. Smug Snake: *Toasteee reveals herself to be one inI Love Money.

characters.name: Somethin
characters.description: Potty Failure:SOMETHIN IN SEASON TWO.It ends up being the reason she gets eliminated.This is, however, combined withPotty Emergency, as Somethin admitted that she wanted to use the restroom during eliminations, but the producers of the show refused to allow her to. So this incident isn't completely her fault.
